comments:
This is from one of the agent's tests, so I assume its appearance is due to #8785 being merged.

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/bc72a718c4e537f8cff37e638320708de1788041/tsdb/agent/db_test.go#L69-L156

review_comments: It can be assumed that this error was because the storage couldn't be created, so I went ahead and simplified the error checks.

I'm not actually sure why the tests here were re-opening the WAL (they came from grafana#22 and I didn't notice that this was happening initially). I ran into this causing problems in #9623 and removed the duplicate opens. 

Doing the same here might help remove the need for the `defer func()`, maybe?
(that is, I think a lot of the problem is that these tests are opening the DB twice when they don't seem to need to)
@spaparaju Do you happen to remember why the tests were doing this?

@rfratto I see some disconnect here. Currently at the Prometheus main branch, I could not see the agent tests (`/tsdb/agent/storage_test.go` file is missing) that I included as part of these two PRs ([first](https://github.com/grafana/prometheus/pull/22/files), [second](https://github.com/grafana/prometheus/pull/24/files)).
They were renamed to db_test.go as part of a request to use DB to be consistent with the full TSDB. :)
This seems to be missing a Close()
